All 15 checkouts verified at their pinned commits; every path below confirmed with `git cat-file -e <commit>:<path>`.

The defect: `useMutationState` in the Svelte adapter of TanStack Query keeps a `$state` array projecting the mutation cache and updates it with `Object.assign(result, nextResult)` — which overwrites indices and appends, but never shortens `length`, so a shrinking mutation set leaves stale, still-reactive entries. Its own package already has the converging counterpart (`createRawRef.update` in `containers.svelte.ts`, which deletes keys that are gone), and the contract is owned elsewhere by tldraw's `IncrementalSetConstructor` (adds *and* removes while still yielding the whole set) and React's keyed child reconciliation (deletes children whose keys disappeared).
